semiconductor_relevance: High — KITZ SCT specializes in ultra-high purity fluid system components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: KITZ SCT Corporation is a leading manufacturer of ultra-high purity valves and fluid delivery systems for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include diaphragm valves, bellows valves, and integrated systems designed to enhance productivity and meet the stringent requirements of semiconductor fabrication.
